نتكافل (form VI)
# نَتَكَافَلُ (natakāfalu) /na.ta.kaː.fa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# نَتَكَافَلَ (natakāfala) /na.ta.kaː.fa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# نَتَكَافَلْ (natakāfal) /na.ta.kaː.fal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
